name: ION.A
detailed_description:
The graphic novel "ION.A" is a dive into the terrifying dreams of the fading City. The protagonist - a man with an unknown name and past - has come here in search of something infinitely important. Uncover the secrets of the City together with him. On the way the hero will meet many people, and each of them has their own motives. Someone wants to help, someone to harm, and someone to deceive and misdirect. And it depends only on you whether the hero will achieve his goals or will forever remain on the dirty streets of the City. With each chapter new secrets will be revealed and, in the end, it is you who will decide the fate of this world. Welcome to the City!

"ION.A" is a non-linear visual novel in the genre of mystical realism. The protagonist arrives in a quiet, unremarkable city, in search of solving the mysteries that have long tormented him. As the story develops, he encounters the locals, each of whom hides his own secret, and the city begins to reveal to him its dark and dangerous sides.

The first chapter of the story is available in the demo version. We plan to release several more chapters as the game goes into early access. And will post the story in its entirety in time for release.

What to expect from our story:

  • A fascinating dark plot, with several ending options.
  • Stylish graphics and atmosphere familiar to everyone.
  • Original soundtrack.
  • Unexpected plot twists and turns.
    ]

    "Warning. This game contains scenes of physical and moral violence, as well as profanity. Be careful and take care of yourself!"

The text of the novel contains descriptions of violent scenes: fights, attacks on people by other people and animals, murders.
The visuals contain scenes of smoking.
Background sounds may contain foul language.
